function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More | |-------|------------|--------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on freeways, 35 mph on expressways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 years or 4 ft 9 in tall must use a child safety seat. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held devices are prohibited while driving.
• Hands‑free devices allowed. | TxDOT – Cell‑Phone Use | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers 21–24 (BAC ≥ 0.02 %) and minors (any BAC).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs; yield at yield signs.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for intersections without signs. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights on from sunset to sunrise, or when visibility < 1 mi.
• Fog lights only when fog < 1 mi. | TxDOT – Lighting Requirements | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not pass on the right unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus** | • Stop for all vehicles when a school bus stops to pick up/drop off children. | TxDOT – School Bus Rules | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, 10 ft of a stop sign, or 15 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking on sidewalks. | TxDOT – Parking Regulations | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and inspected annually.
• Failure to register can result in fines and towing. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Cameras enforce speed limits and red‑light violations. | TxDOT – Traffic Enforcement | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Roadside Assistance & Towing** | • Roadside assistance is available through the Texas Highway Patrol. | Texas Highway Patrol | --- ### How to Get Official Texts 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online at the Texas Legislature’s website. 2. **TxDOT Publications** – PDF guides on speed limits, lighting, and parking. 3. **TxDMV** – Registration, inspection, and driver licensing information. 4. **TABC** – DUI laws and penalties. --- ### Quick Tips - **Always check posted signs** – they override general rules. - **Use hands‑free** – cell‑phone laws are strictly enforced. - **Keep your registration and inspection stickers visible** – they’re required by law. - **Know the school‑zone speed limits** – they’re lower than normal limits. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
